title: Enterprise Signal Funnel: Sales/CS Intake — Aggregation, Rapid Scoping & Prioritization Guide
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a repeatable, low-friction process for Sales and Customer Success to aggregate enterprise feature requests (non-bug), perform a 20-30 minute rapid scoping pass, prioritize by business and technical risk, and produce standardized handoffs to PM/Design/Eng. This playbook targets requests that come from committed enterprise conversations and are likely to trigger dedicated capacity, security, or roadmap discussions.
objective: Reduce time-to-first-scope to <72 hours for high-impact enterprise asks; provide a single canonical aggregation artifact for each account; enable consistent prioritization signals across GTM and product teams.
scope_included: Feature requests from enterprise customers surfaced by Sales/CS (non-bug)
Initial aggregation of related asks across accounts and internal threads
A 6-point prioritization score (value, frequency, fit, cost, data sensitivity, strategic alignment)
Template-based 1-page scoping note and recommended next step (Investigate / Design spike / Prototype / Candidate roadmap)
Handoff checklist and routing rules for PM, Design, and Eng triage
scope_out_of_scope: Individual bug reports and incidents (use incident intake)
Deep technical spec or implementation design work
Proof-of-concept engineering or paid professional services deliveries
intake_template: Use the 'Enterprise One-Pager' template (Account, Request summary, Business outcome, Users/flows affected, Data classification, Acceptable latency/cost targets, Any regulatory constraints, Initial askor contact and urgency). Link this to the linear ticket as the canonical artifact.
scoring_heuristic: Value (0-5): revenue/opportunity size or retention upside
Frequency (0-5): number of customers/accounts requesting or similar use cases
Fit (0-5): aligns with product vision and core platform capabilities
Implementation Cost (0-5): rough engineering effort and infra cost
Data Sensitivity (0-5): regulatory/PII/hosting constraints raising complexity
Strategic Signal (0-5): partner requirements, marquee customer, or competitive urgency
quick_scoping_steps: 1) Aggregation: consolidate inbound asks for the same capability across CS notes, Sales deals, and any existing GH issues or support threads
2) One-pager: fill out Enterprise One-Pager in the ticket within 48 hours
3) Score: apply the 6-point heuristic to produce a total score and tag Low/Medium/High
4) Triage decision: recommended next step (no-op, monitor, research spike, design story, roadmap candidate)
5) Assign owner: CS rep remains request owner; PM triage owner assigned within 72 hours for High/Strategic
6) Communication: send a templated response to customer with expected timeline and next touchpoint
acceptance_criteria: A templated Enterprise One-Pager exists and is used on 90%+ of Sales/CS-submitted requests
Scoring heuristic computed and stored on the Linear ticket for every aggregated request
Handoff rules consistently route High-priority asks to PM within 72 hours
Documented examples (3) of accepted/ rejected asks with rationale available in the playbook
Runbook for CS: canned responses and SLAs for acknowledgement, initial scoping, and follow-up
handoff_and_escalation: If score >= 20 (out of 30): auto-escalate to Senior PM and Solutions Eng for immediate review
If data sensitivity >=4: include Security and Compliance in the initial triage meeting
For roadmap candidates: attach to the monthly Roadmap Review board and add to product intake sync
For small-impact asks: label 'monitor' and add to the quarterly customer signals digest
